On this day 7 years ago, #EricGarner was killed by the NYPD. Today, we remember & honor his life, we say his name, & we continue to uplift demands for @NYCMayor & the NYPD to fire ALL officers who were part of the misconduct & cover-up related to his killing. 

#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/RkbF1PRbi3

.@NYCMayor today is a good day to #FireNYPD officers responsible for the killing of:
#DelrawnSmall
#KawaskiTrawick
#AntonioWilliams
#AllanFeliz
& the cover-up of #EricGarner's killing!
#BlackLivesMatter #NYPD #AccountabilityMatters

Currently thinking about those no longer with us, specifically those whose lives were stolen by #NYPD officers. #FireNYPD #BlackLivesMatter 
#DefundNYPD #InvestInCommunities https://t.co/e2WCi487dV

Plainclothes NYPD units did not create safety, but they did target Black, Latinx, and other New Yorkers of color with violence and discrimination, and violated their human rights. #BlackLivesMatter #RedefineSafety
https://t.co/McegvGSaP0

Aug. 9, 1997, #AbnerLouima, a Haitian American, became the victim of brutal #NYPD police violence, he was brutalized, and sexually assaulted in Brooklyn's 70th Precinct. In 2001, after huge protests, he won a police brutality settlement of $8.75M ($13M today). #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/vbvm67ZFlI
